nodes.question: How does marine water eutrophication change across quartiles of ultraprocessed food and drink consumption?
nodes.answer: Marine water eutrophication decreased by -1.3%, -1.4%, and -1.5% in the quartiles of ultraprocessed food and drink consumption, from low to high consumption levels.
